name: Gaussian Splatting Initialization and Parameterization
definition: Initializes a set of 3D Gaussians from COLMAP point cloud data (xyz, rgb) by creating learnable parameters for position, features, scaling, rotation, and opacity.
summary: Gaussian Splatting Initialization and Parameterization establishes valid 3D Gaussian parameters for volume rendering optimization, distinguishing itself by handling full geometric and attribute seeding from sparse reconstruction data rather than just color or uniform sampling.
